item.description:
### Changed
- The app menu reads About, Help, Hide and Quit, as the menu bar menu does. - Two fingers move the thumbnails' tray in a short push: toward a side is enough for that side's corner, and several strokes in a row add up. - History: drag a frame from between the cells to pick several captures, as in Finder; ⌘ or ⇧ adds to what is picked.
### Fixed
- DeepSnap always looks for updates on its own. - DeepSnap no longer quits now and then while you select an area. - History: several picked captures dragged to a folder all go there, not just the one under the pointer.
